venues.name: Scotiabank Arena

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Scotiabank Arena Ticket Office is located on the North corner of the building across from Gate 1. It is open on event days only, beginning three (3) hours prior to event time.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Scotiabank Arena does not accept will-call, it is a fully mobile venue. When purchasing tickets, there will be a mobile delivery method, which allows for convenient and efficient management of your tickets, instantly! For more information on mobile ticketing at Scotiabank Arena, please visit https://mobile.mlse.com/venue/scotiabank-arena

venues.parkingDetail: Public parking is available on Queens Quay, Bay Street and surrounding areas. We also encourage public transportation, with Union Station just north of the stadium, serving both the TTC and GO Transit. For parking information call Impark: (416) 369-1801; there are more than 13,000 public parking spaces within immediate walking distance of the arena. Fans requiring accessible parking are asked to call (416) 815-5982 in order to reserve a spot.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Scotiabank Arena is fully accessible through all gates. When available, accessible seating can be purchased online at www.ticketmaster.ca. Accessible Parking and Drop off: Fans requiring accessible parking at Scotiabank Arena are asked to call 416-815-5982 in order to reserve a spot (up to 4 weeks in advance). Fans who being dropped off by Wheel-Trans or private vehicles may do so on Bremner Boulevard on the west side of the building, nearest to Gate 5. For more information on accessing Scotiabank Arena, please contact Fan Services at the venue at (416)815-5982, Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm. Assistive Listening Devices: Available for Leafs and Raptors games. Currently unavailable for concerts.

generalInfo.generalRule: As a security measure, no re-entry is permitted after you have exited the Scotiabank Arena gates. Only small purses, clutch, or fanny pack type bags smaller than 16.5cm x 11.5cm (6.5"x4.5") are permitted. No outside food or beverages. No smoking in the venue. Alcohol is not permitted on any General Admission floor seating. No outside food or beverages permitted. SCOTIABANK ARENA ALCOHOL POLICIES ARE SUBJECT TO CHANGE ON AN EVENT BY EVENT BASIS. For more information on Scotiabank Arena, please visit our Know Before You Go page at https://www.scotiabankarena.com/know-before-you-go-1
generalInfo.childRule: Children under 24 months of age do not require a ticket if seated on a lap (for concerts this is subject to change). Children 24 months and older do require a ticket.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Monday-Friday 10am-4pm but hours are subject to change. For more information visit https://roythomsonhall.mhrth.com/box-office-and-venue-info/
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call is available only on the day of the performance. Please arrive at ticket office early if picking up tickets. Customers must present the credit card used to place the order and photo ID

venues.parkingDetail: The underground garage at Roy Thomson Hall is convenient, clean, brightly lit and well signed. There are two levels with combined capacity for 377 cars. Parking is available on a first-come, first-served basis. The garage entrance is on Wellington Street, west of Simcoe Street. Hours: 24 hours. The garage is closed holidays.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available for all events. For more information visit https://www.roythomsonhall.com/box-office-and-venue-info/accessibility

generalInfo.generalRule: Venue Information can be found here: https://roythomsonhall.mhrth.com/box-office-and-venue-info/ We share the air, go scent free: Please be considerate of those in the audience who may have allergies and/or multiple chemical sensitivities and refrain from wearing cologne and perfume or other scented products. All patrons entering Roy Thomson Hall will be subject to a bag search. This includes all handbags, purses and backpacks. Please note that large bags unable to fit under your seat will not be permitted at Roy Thomson Hall. We encourage you to leave large bags and items at home or to arrange storage elsewhere as we are not able to offer bag check on these items. Permitted bags should be soft sided and able to fit completely under the auditorium seats. An exception will be made for declared medically necessary items, after proper inspection.
generalInfo.childRule: All patrons must have a ticket for entry. For most performances*, children under 2 may enter without paid admission, when accompanied by an adult - subject to venue capacity. Please see door staff for a babe in arms pass. Children under 2 must remain seated in the lap of an accompanying adult and may not occupy another seat For more information please contact the box office at 416-872-4255 or by emailing contactus@mh-rth.com/ *Individual performances may have additional restrictions.

events.name: Music Toronto presents Escher String Quartet
events.info: Escher String Quartet makes its Music Toronto debut with a program that moves from Classical brilliance to late-Romantic intensity. Joseph Haydn's sparkling Op. 76 No. 1 opens the evening, followed by the lush cinematic voice of Erich Wolfgang Korngold's rarely heard Third Quartet, before the profound lyricism and drama of Johannes Brahms's A minor Quartet. Formed in 2005, the Escher is named for the Dutch graphic artist M.C. Escher, inspired by his method of interplay between individual components working together to form a whole.

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: TO Live Box Office Phone Support: 416-366-7723 or 1-800-708-6754 || Venue Website: www.tolive.com
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Daytime box office hours are Monday to Friday, 1:00pm to 6:00pm. On performance days, the box office opens 2 hour prior to the first scheduled curtain time, and stays open until 30 minutes after curtain time.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: American Express, MasterCard, Visa, Debit, Cash
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: In advance of shows, tickets can be picked up during daytime hours at any TO Live box office (Meridian Arts Centre, Meridian Hall, St. Lawrence Center for the Arts). On show days, tickets will be available for pickup from 2 hours prior to the scheduled curtain time. Please arrive early to avoid congestion and delays, and be prepared to present the actual credit card used for purchase and photo ID.

venues.parkingDetail: Public parking is available at nearby lots, and limited metered street parking is available on surrounding streets. For more information, please visit www.stlc.com/location/. Limited onsite parking is available at Meridian Hall (next door to the St. Lawrence Centre) for patrons with Accessible Needs, and must be arranged in advanced by calling 416-733-9388 ext. 6900.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: There are several Accessible Seating options available depending on your needs. Please contact the TO Live Box Office at 416-366-7723, option #3 or 1-800-708-6754, option #3 to discuss your options and to book Accessible Seats. Hearing assistance devices are available for the Bluma Appel Theatre only through our Patrons Services team on a first-come, first-served basis, and cannot be reserved in advance.

generalInfo.generalRule: No smoking is permitted in the building.
generalInfo.childRule: All patrons including babies-in-arms require a ticket of admission. If a child has not yet celebrated their first birthday, a "babes-in-arms" ticket may be obtained, free of charge, at the box office as of 2 hours prior to the scheduled curtain time. Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult , and if children are being noisy and disrupting the performance the child and guardian may be asked to step out into the lobby. Please note that individual performances may have additional age restrictions, warnings, or other arrangements than those outlined here, so please see the event page for full details.
